highlights: 修复多账号额度查询串读：额度查询绑定对应账号的浏览器页面，避免不同账号间显示错误余额和用量。
额度读取失败或未读到有效数据时保留旧缓存，并明确报告失败状态，避免把无效结果当成实时额度。
修复保活成功误报：区分唤醒请求已接受与 VM 已运行，只有复核状态为 RUNNING 才报告唤醒成功。
管理页显示额度查询时间和过期提示；账号测试分别反馈会话有效性和额度读取状态。
维护探测不再更新最后使用时间，后台保活按续期需要执行，避免维护流量被计为用户使用或频繁触发保活。
新增离线回归测试，覆盖账号额度隔离及 VM 唤醒状态确认。
额度查询适配简体中文、繁体中文和英文界面，兼容全角字符、小数百分比及 0% 用量。
修复额度面板定位与关闭流程；未读到有效额度时保留旧缓存，不再把无效结果当成实时数据。
管理页针对非 JSON 错误显示明确的 HTTP 状态提示，避免泄露代理返回的 HTML 错误页。
highlights_en: Fixed quota reads leaking between accounts: each quota query is now bound to that account's browser page, so accounts no longer show each other's balance and usage.
When reading the quota fails or returns no valid data, the old cache is kept and the failure is reported clearly, instead of treating invalid results as live quota.
Fixed false keep-alive success: a wake request being accepted is now distinguished from the VM actually running, and wake-up is only reported as successful once the re-checked state is RUNNING.
The admin page shows when the quota was last checked and warns when it is stale; account tests report session validity and quota read status separately.

Maintenance probes no longer update the last-used time, and background keep-alive only runs when renewal is needed, so maintenance traffic is not counted as user activity or triggers keep-alive too often.
Added offline regression tests covering per-account quota isolation and VM wake-state confirmation.
Quota reading now supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English page layouts, including full-width characters, decimal percentages and 0% usage.
Fixed locating and closing the quota panel; when no valid quota is read, the old cache is kept and invalid results are no longer treated as live data.
For non-JSON errors the admin page now shows a clear HTTP status hint instead of leaking the proxy's HTML error page.
